units.source_text: 对上述“不归者宣告失踪”申请一案，已履行了公开催促通告的手续，

en.t: Regarding the above petition to declare the missing person legally disappeared, the procedure for issuing a public summons has already been completed,

units.source_text: 经认定，自昭和三十年八月十八日以来，七年以上生死不明，特作如下判决。

en.t: and it has been determined that since August 18, Showa 30, his whereabouts and survival have been unknown for more than seven years; therefore the following judgment is rendered.
